items.title: 21.10 Ocean currents and wind patterns (samandari dhaarein aur hawa ke patterns) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of ocean currents and wind patterns (PDF 179).

blocks.text: Ocean currents (samandari dhaarein) aur wind patterns (hawa ke patterns) zameen ke climate aur mausam ko regulate karne (qaboo mein rakhne) mein aham kirdar ada karte hain. Ocean currents samandar ke pani ki bohat bare paimane ki movement (harkat) se bante hain. Samandar ka pani do tareeqon se circulate karta hai (ghoomta hai): surface (oopar) par aur gehri layers ke darmiyan. Surface currents zyada tar hawa se bante hain jo samandar ki oopar wali layer ka pani dhakelti hai. Pani ki vertical (oopar-neeche) circulation ko thermohaline circulation kehte hain. Yeh pani ke temperature aur salinity (namkeenpan) ke farq se chalti hai, kyunke yeh dono pani ki density par asar karte hain (21.13 aur 21.14 dekhein). Zameen ka ghoomna (rotation) bhi samandar ki movement ko shape deta hai aur bare gol current systems banata hai jinhein gyres kehte hain. Yeh northern hemisphere (zameen ka shimali, yani upar wala aadha hissa) mein clockwise (ghari ki suiyon ki taraf) aur southern hemisphere (neeche wala aadha hissa) mein anticlockwise ghoomte hain. Currents garam pani equator se poles ki taraf le jati hain aur thanda pani wapas lati hain, jis se zameen ka climate control mein rehta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit! (Dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Purane sailors (malahon) ko safar mein madad dene wali trade winds zameen ke ghoomne aur Sooraj ki garmi se chalti hain. Ocean currents duniya ke mausami pattern badal kar aik area mein floods (selab) aur doosre mein drought (khushk-sali, barish na hona) la sakti hain.

blocks.prompt: Southern hemisphere mein aik storm system (toofan) clockwise ghoomta dekha gaya. Agar wahi system northern hemisphere mein ho to kis taraf ghoomega, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Anticlockwise. Coriolis effect chalti hawa ko southern hemisphere mein baen (left) aur northern hemisphere mein daen (right) morta hai, is liye low pressure (kam dabao) wale toofan ki taraf aane wali hawa dono hemispheres mein ulti direction mein ghoomti hai.

blocks.text: Samandar ki surface par gyres ke patterns Fig. 21.11 mein dikhaye gaye hain. Hawa ke patterns zameen ki surface ke barabar garam na hone (uneven heating) se bante hain: garam hawa oopar uthti hai aur thandi hawa us ki jagah aati hai. Is se hawa ke alag belts bante hain, jaise trade winds, westerlies aur polar easterlies. Yeh hawayein na sirf samandar ki surface ka pani chalati hain balke ocean currents ki direction aur taqat par bhi asar karti hain. Wind patterns aur ocean currents mil kar poori zameen par heat (garmi) aur energy phailate hain, aur climate zones aur mausam ko badalte hain.

blocks.alt: Duniya ka map aur paanch samandari gyres: North Pacific aur North Atlantic clockwise; South Pacific, South Atlantic aur Indian anticlockwise. Orange arrows garam aur neele arrows thandi currents; garam pani basins ke west (maghribi) kinaron par. Antarctic circumpolar current neeche west se east ki taraf behti hai. Legend: cold current, warm current.

items: Surface currents: hawa se; vertical circulation (thermohaline): temperature aur salinity (density) se.
Gyres: northern mein clockwise, southern mein anticlockwise.
Wind belts: trade winds, westerlies, polar easterlies; currents ke saath heat phailate hain.
